task: Some people think students should not bring phones to school. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples.
text: Although phones can be distracting, I believe students should be allowed to bring them to school. First, they are a powerful learning tool: for example, I use a dictionary app every day to check new words. Second, phones keep students safe, since parents can reach them if plans change. Of course, there must be clear rules, such as keeping phones in bags during lessons, so that everyone can concentrate.

task: Describe a trip you remember well. Where did you go, what happened, and how did you feel?
text: The trip I remember best was to Sa Pa two years ago. We took a night train, and when I woke up, the mountains were covered in mist. During the trek, I slipped on the wet path and my little sister laughed so hard that I started laughing too. In the evening we had hot soup in a tiny village house. I felt tired but incredibly happy, and I still look at the photos whenever I miss that weekend.
